title.narrative: Centres of Excellence in Marine Sciences and Biodiversity for Lusophone SIDS

description.narrative: This UN Joint Project aims to strengthen national capacities in targeted AIS Small Island Developing States (SIDS) to utilize Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI) effectively for advancing climate resilience and nature-based solutions in alignment with the Sustainable Development Goals. For such, the project pursues two main outcomes: 1) Enhanced capacities of policymakers and relevant stakeholders in the targeted SIDS to leverage STI for SDG implementation, with a particular emphasis on the blue economy and integrated climate action. The second outcome is strengthening institutional capacities of national research institutions and training centres for scientific knowledge production in the files of marine science and biodiversity. UNESCO contributes to the national baseline assessments in outcome1 and leads the deliverables of outcome2.
